scope: Prospective replication of the completed SF Trust Youth Initiative dose. Not current AIM pricing, federal RHY prevention, residential housing, or the whole organization.

judgments.label: Cash per participant
judgments.basis: Published SF TYI entitlement: $1,500 monthly for 24 months plus $4,500 = $40,500. Historic nominal dose retained without inflation adjustment; not an AIM quote.

judgments.label: Support and administration
judgments.basis: Central assumed $10,000: 96 staff hours over 24 months at an assumed $100 loaded hourly cost, plus $400 administration. Includes unsuccessful engagement; not observed Larkin spending. Positive stress cases $5,000/$20,000.

judgments.label: Extra stable-housing person-years
judgments.basis: Judgment: half a year newly housed over 30 months versus ordinary services, equivalent to 20% of the observed window. This gives partial rather than near-total credit because ordinary services also improve housing; it is a provisional decision assumption, not a calibrated empirical estimate. Stress cases 0.1–1 year. Not derived from the reported 86% housing rate, before–after nights, or NYC enrollment-group difference; clean cumulative causal housing-day data are unavailable.

judgments.label: Health utility per additional housed year
judgments.basis: Explicit subjective 0.05 (0.01–0.10): a modest health-related quality improvement of five percentage points during extra housed time, not credit for all housing benefits, not measured by TYI and not a validated homelessness-to-QALY conversion. It credits only health-related quality of life; shares uncertainty with other housing models.

judgments.label: Additional donor-financed capacity
judgments.basis: 50% judgment (25–75%) for replacement of already financed cash/support. Housing effect above is already relative to services as usual; do not apply a second causal housing discount.

nullBoundary: Zero extra housing, zero utility gain, or full funding substitution yields no finite positive-benefit price. Harm remains possible and is not assigned a positive price. Positive scenarios are judgmental stress tests, not confidence bounds. The 30-month horizon excludes later effects.

fundingRoom.nextEvidence: A priced additional cash-plus tranche, payment and support cost ledger, original-assignment cumulative housing-day trajectories with missingness sensitivity, and an AIM/RHY/TYI funding crosswalk.

financialContext.amountSemantics: Audited organization-wide accrued revenue and expenses; not cash paid, marginal program costs, or available private funding room.

excluded: Income, autonomy, education and justice benefits outside the health-utility bridge
Government savings and transfer recipients' cash value as separate QALYs
Other Larkin housing, employment and engagement programs
